question: In which of the following sports/games is the attacking player known as a 'raider'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kabaddi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Kabaddi, the attacking player is called a** 'raider,' **who enters the opponent's half to tag players and score points.
 
• The raider must** hold their breath and chant "kabaddi"** while attempting to return to their side without being tackled.
 
• The role of the raider is crucial in the game, as they are responsible for scoring points for their team.
